explanation: Format by extracting decimal digits from the magnitude and joining them in reverse. Parse by folding signed decimal characters with multiply-by-ten and addition; Python integers hold the sign’s magnitude directly.
timeComplexity: O(d) arithmetic/character steps for d digits
spaceComplexity: O(d) formatting buffers; O(1) fixed-width parsing state
